Pedimos que todos os competidores tragam pelo menos um cubo 3x3 lacrado para doação ou um item relacionado com STEM, que será doado a um paciente pediátrico com câncer. Consulte a aba [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerManaus2026#71878-cube-against-cancer) para obter mais informações. --- **🇺🇸 English (en-US)** This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerManaus2026#71878-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.
